name: ENPRO
recent: Enproserve 在 2026 年 9 月获得 Perbadanan Putrajaya 价值 RM12mil 的设施管理合约，并在 11 月签署了谅解备忘录。最新季度（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）营收环比增长 79.8%，但净利同比下滑 24.8%。董事兼大股东 Azman bin Yusof 在 10 月底至 11 月期间多次增持股份。
notable: 获得 Perbadanan Putrajaya 价值 RM12mil 的设施管理合约。
签署谅解备忘录（细节未披露）。
董事兼大股东 Azman bin Yusof 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
risks: 最新季度净利同比下滑 24.8%，尽管营收同比增长 20.7%。
董事在闭门期前表示有意交易公司股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 50.16mil，环比增长 79.8%，同比增长 20.7%；净利为 MYR 997k，净利率 2.0%，净利同比下滑 24.8%。

recent_en: Enproserve secured a RM12mil facility management contract from Perbadanan Putrajaya in September 2026 and signed a memorandum of understanding in November. Latest quarter (ended 30 Sep 2026) revenue rose 79.8% QoQ but net profit fell 24.8% YoY. Director and major shareholder Azman bin Yusof acquired shares multiple times between late October and November.
notable_en: Secured a RM12mil facility management contract from Perbadanan Putrajaya.
Signed a memorandum of understanding (details not disclosed).
Director and major shareholder Azman bin Yusof acquired shares in the open market multiple times.
risks_en: Latest quarter net profit fell 24.8% YoY despite revenue growing 20.7% YoY.
Director indicated intention to deal in company shares ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR 50.16mil, up 79.8% QoQ and 20.7% YoY; net profit was MYR 997k with a 2.0% net margin, down 24.8% YoY.
